summary.intent: Resolve open PR review comments on a release-gate workflow, specifically fixing fallback search logic to use correct success/total comparisons.
summary.outcome: Fixed fallback loops in release-gate.yml to use `SUCCESS == TOTAL` instead of a weaker condition, cleaned up now-unused `FAILED` variable, committed and pushed.

repo: release-gate.yml has both HEAD checks and fallback search loops for Desktop E2E and Web E2E; they must use consistent success conditions.
The fallback loops previously used an `exit 0` short-circuit pattern that diverged from the HEAD check pattern — now unified to if/else.

code.finding: Fallback search loops for Desktop E2E and Web E2E now gate on `SUCCESS == TOTAL`, matching the HEAD check logic. The `FAILED` variable was removed as it became unused once `SUCCESS == TOTAL` was the sole condition.

workflow: CodeRabbit or another automated reviewer flagged the inconsistency between HEAD checks and fallback loops — automated review caught a real logic bug.
Workflow: fetch unresolved GraphQL threads → triage → fix → typecheck/test → commit → reply and resolve each thread.

friction: Multiple read-edit cycles were needed because the FAILED variable cleanup required a second pass after the initial SUCCESS == TOTAL fix.
